description: Lists the team's webhook endpoints with URL, events, status and last delivery. Use when the user asks which webhooks exist, whether one is failing, or needs a webhook ID. Not for delivery history (use list_webhook_deliveries). Returns endpoints with IDs; a team can have up to 10. Signing secrets are never returned.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_webhooks
title: List webhooks
